Automated Model Briefing

⚠ AI-generated text — may be wrong, incomplete, or overconfident. This is automated commentary on experimental model output, not flight advice and not a weather forecast. It has not been reviewed by a meteorologist.

Overall Assessment — A complex day with good thermal potential but widespread rain and overdevelopment risks. Strong southwest flow arrives by late afternoon, bringing gusty post-frontal winds that shut down most sites by 4pm. Pilots should target late morning through early afternoon before conditions deteriorate.

Site Breakdown

  • Kingsbury Grade: Marginal — favorable SE flow early, but winds swing SW and spike to 22 mph at 16:00. Flying window: 8am–3pm. Peak w* 337 fpm, thermal ceiling 4,399 ft AGL. Sharp thermals — advanced pilots only.
  • Hallelujah: Unfavorable — rain and 68% cloud cover, plus weak/variable winds through peak heating. Flying window: 11am–2pm. Peak w* 413 fpm, thermal ceiling 4,967 ft AGL. Sharp thermals — advanced pilots only.
  • Slide Mountain: Marginal — rain risk and gusty SW winds 18–22 mph after 15:00. Flying window: 8am–3pm. Peak w* 386 fpm, thermal ceiling 2,334 ft AGL.
  • McClellan: Favorable — best thermal site with good NW flow 10–15 mph and 469 fpm climbs. Rain risk present. Flying window: 11am–4pm. Peak w* 469 fpm, thermal ceiling 4,402 ft AGL. Sharp thermals — advanced pilots only.
  • West McClellan: Unfavorable — rain, 27% overdevelopment risk, and gusty W winds 16–21 mph after 16:00. Flying window: 12pm–3pm. Peak w* 411 fpm, thermal ceiling 3,560 ft AGL.
  • Peavine Mountain: Unfavorable — rain, significant directional shear (33° at 1,283 ft AGL), and strong W winds 22 mph by 19:00. Flying window: 10am–2pm. Peak w* 345 fpm, thermal ceiling 2,685 ft AGL.
  • Rainbow Ridge: Marginal — rain, directional shear (34° at 5,069 ft AGL), with NW winds building to 16 mph after 19:00. Flying window: 10am–3pm. Peak w* 456 fpm, thermal ceiling 4,762 ft AGL. Sharp thermals — advanced pilots only.
  • Duck Hill: Marginal — severe directional shear (49° at 957 ft AGL) and rain risk. Evening potential after 17:00 with steady W flow. Flying window: 11am–3pm. Peak w* 405 fpm, thermal ceiling 4,553 ft AGL. Sharp thermals — advanced pilots only.
  • Daydreams: Unfavorable — extreme 55% overdevelopment risk, rain, and gusty SW winds 19–21 mph at 14:00. Flying window: 8am–1pm. Peak w* 285 fpm, thermal ceiling 3,692 ft AGL.

Hazards

  • Rain — Widespread rain flagged at Hallelujah, Slide Mountain, McClellan, West McClellan, Peavine Mountain, Rainbow Ridge, Duck Hill, and Daydreams.
  • Overdevelopment — High risk at Daydreams (55%), West McClellan (27%), Slide Mountain (14%), and McClellan (14%); cloud base near thermal tops will limit climb heights.
  • Low-level directional shear — Duck Hill (49° shift at 957 ft AGL), Rainbow Ridge (34° at 5,069 ft AGL), and Peavine Mountain (33° at 1,283 ft AGL) exceed 30° threshold — turbulence near inversion layers.
  • Low-level speed shear — McClellan (7 mph at 4,083 ft AGL), West McClellan (6 mph at 2,772 ft AGL), Rainbow Ridge (6 mph at 5,069 ft AGL), Kingsbury Grade (3 mph at 1,930 ft AGL), Hallelujah (5 mph at 4,394 ft AGL), Slide Mountain (5 mph at 569 ft AGL), Peavine Mountain (5 mph at 1,283 ft AGL), and Duck Hill (5 mph at 957 ft AGL) — potential for rough air and gust line passage.
  • Rotor/lee turbulence — Downwind of Peavine Mountain and Carson Range ridgelines as SW flow intensifies after 15:00.
  • Icing — Freezing level ~10,400–10,700 ft MSL; climb-outs approaching this altitude risk airframe icing if precipitation is encountered.
  • Sharp thermals — Lapse rates of 8.7–9.7 °C/km at Kingsbury Grade, Hallelujah, McClellan, Rainbow Ridge, Duck Hill, and Daydreams; advanced pilots only at these sites.

Site Forecast ?Top of Thermals (PBLH) — height of the turbulent mixing layer; thermals typically reach this ceiling.
LCL (Lifted Condensation Level) — altitude where rising air reaches its dew point; theoretical cloud base.
Cloud Base — lowest model level with >10% cloud fraction.
w* — convective velocity scale; higher = stronger thermals (ft/min).
Cloud Cover — max cloud fraction over the column (0–100%).
Wind thresholds: orange = 12 mph, red = 18 mph.
